intro: You are not feeling well. Describe your problem to the doctor clearly.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Good morning. Please sit down. What is troubling you?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Describe what is wrong with you.
expected: I have a pain in my stomach.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: I see. Since when have you had this?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say how long you have had it.
expected: I have had it for two days.

conversation.speaker: student
expected: It is worse in the morning.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Have you taken any medicine for it?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say whether you have taken anything.
expected: No, I have not taken anything.
Yes, I took a tablet last night.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Do not worry. Rest for two days and you will feel better.

conversation.speaker: student

Thank you doctor. Should I come again?
